scope.supports: The real power equation (3/5)^p+(4/5)^p=1 iff p=2 is kernel checked. Integer p=1..8 reproduce actual shared-ray context weights; mixed-sign p=1 supplies a retained counterexample to unrestricted Sorkin vanishing.
scope.does_not_support: The power-law family, real exponentiation and the real orthonormal contexts are admitted; formal transport of the concrete context normalization to the Real.rpow equation remains a separate bridge. No unrestricted readout uniqueness or Gleason theorem follows.
